title: How much water do you need when you lift? 💧
caption:
Losing about 2% of your body weight in sweat can hurt endurance and a bit of strength. Check your pee colour, sip during training, and after long sweaty sessions drink about 1.5 litres for every kilo lost. Water bottle always in the gym? 👇

General information, not medical advice.

Diet & Food #3
first_comment: Gallon jug gang or one tiny sip gang? 💧
